name: gexno-web3
description: Free Ethereum wallet profile & NFT metadata tools for AI agents (no signup).
long_description: Look up any Ethereum wallet balance, contract flag, tx count, and simple risk heuristics; resolve ERC-721/1155 NFT metadata and IPFS image HTTP URLs. Talks to the Gexno Web3 Agent API over HTTP.

tools.name: lookup_wallet
tools.description: Look up ETH balance, contract/EIP-7702 flags, tx count, and simple risk heuristics for an address

tools.name: lookup_nft
tools.description: Resolve NFT metadata and IPFS HTTP image links for a contract + tokenId

api_base.title: API Base URL
api_base.description: Gexno API root without trailing slash. Local: http://127.0.0.1:3000 — Production: https://api.gexno.com

internal_token.title: Internal Token (optional)
internal_token.description: Same value as server WEB3_INTERNAL_TOKEN. Optional; uses a higher rate limit when set. Never commit this value.
